items.text: Meditators report experiences where the boundary between self and world disappears. These experiences are:

options.A: Neural misfirings that feel profound but reveal nothing real
options.B: Interesting altered states without metaphysical significance
options.C: Experiences whose significance is genuinely uncertain
options.D: Potentially meaningful insights worth taking seriously
options.E: Genuine insights into the nature of consciousness and reality

items.text: The "highest" state of human consciousness is:

options.B: Optimal ego functioning with mature self-awareness
options.D: States that expand beyond narrow individual perspective
options.E: Transcendence of individual ego into something larger

items.text: The sense of being a separate, bounded self is:

options.A: Fundamental reality—we are genuinely separate beings
options.D: A useful illusion that obscures deeper connection
options.E: A pervasive illusion hiding our fundamental interconnection
